info.title: Relay API
info.description: Relay's REST API: conversations, contacts, tags, teammates and teams. Authenticate with a personal access token (Settings › Developers) as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Name a version with `Relay-Version`; without one, the token's own version is used.

get.description: The workspace, the teammate the token acts as, its scopes and its version.

400.description: The request isn't valid: the error names the field.

401.description: No token, or one that's been revoked.

403.description: The token's scopes, or its teammate's role, don't allow it.

get.description: Customer-facing conversations, most recently updated first.

parameters.name: assignee_id
parameters.description: Only those assigned to this teammate (`none` for unassigned).

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: The cursor from the previous page's `pages.next`.

400.description: The request isn't valid: the error names the field.

401.description: No token, or one that's been revoked.

403.description: The token's scopes, or its teammate's role, don't allow it.

post.summary: Start a conversation for a contact
post.description: A new conversation, started by the contact with their message (as if they'd written in). Send `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe.
